race.comment: KISS ME IN PARIS (13) will be down in class after a modest run fresh up at Ballarat just over 3 weeks ago. She will strip fitter, and had won a jump-out prior to her last run. A wide gate makes it tough, but she is still the one to beat. BOLD AMORE (1) has needed time to mature, and looks a lot stronger this season after winning back to back jump-outs leading into this suitable assignment. He has had some gear changes, and is good enough to overcome a wide gate to win this. DARK GALAXY (2) is another slow maturing gelding, who has shown glimpses of ability in some races last season. He has been given a solid build up at the jump-outs, winning the most recent of 3 nearly 2 weeks ago. Each way claims fresh up. XTRA BLACK (7) makes his debut from a wide draw, but he has ample talent, and has to be respected.
